reason: Chasing farmers and SME owners for documents is honestly the worst part of my week, so this is the first offer in a while that describes my actual problem. But I would be client number two or three of someone who does this evenings and weekends, and his only reference is a pilot that has not finished yet. I will not put 900 EUR and my clients' WhatsApp into something unproven while I am in the middle of submission season.
objection: A database developer with a day job, 10-12 hours a week, one client every six weeks. The backup person named in the contract is a name on paper; when I have a deadline on Friday and the link breaks on Wednesday, who actually picks up the phone? And my farmers in Bihor are not going to upload photos of their APIA documents from a phone without me calling them anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A phone call with the Bihor consultant after the 60-day pilot, where he tells me the reminders actually got documents out of his clients without him chasing, and shows me his monthly report.
